title: Payoff Operations Method Statement: the Trade-In Payoff Charge
content:
**Method.** On a **Trade-In Agreements** agreement, the payoff charge is the latest recorded payoff quote amount, plus the quote's per diem for each calendar day after its good-through date through the send date, less the per diem for the days of that span that fall after Kestrel's own payoff deadline when the grade's late per-diem switch is on; Kestrel's own payoff deadline is the grade's payoff send business days after the pickup date, counting Monday to Friday only and starting with the first weekday after the pickup date; the payoff charge is rounded to the nearest cent.

## Elements

| Element | Definition |
|---|---|
| Quote amount, per diem, good-through date | Those of the latest recorded payoff quote entry on the agreement's history |
| Per-diem span | Each calendar day after the good-through date through the send date; no day when the send date is on or before the good-through date |
| Kestrel's own payoff deadline | The grade's payoff send business days counted on weekdays only, the first counted day being the first weekday after the pickup date |
| Days after the deadline | The days of the per-diem span that fall after the deadline; with the grade's late per-diem switch on, their per diem is not part of the payoff charge |
| Customer's per-diem days | The per-diem span less the days after the deadline |

## Counting the deadline (hypothetical)

With payoff send business days of 2: a Thursday pickup counts Friday as day 1 and Monday as day 2, so the deadline is the Monday; a Saturday pickup counts Monday and Tuesday, so the deadline is the Tuesday.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Pickup on a Thursday; payoff send business days of 2, so the deadline is the following Monday; late per-diem switch on. Latest quote $12500.00, per diem $5.00, good through the Saturday after pickup. The payoff is sent on the Wednesday after that Monday.

1. Per-diem span: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, which is 4 days.
2. Days after the deadline: Tuesday and Wednesday, which is 2 days.
3. Customer's per-diem days: 4 less 2, which is 2.
4. Payoff charge: $12500.00 plus $5.00 multiplied by 2, which is **$12510.00**.

Sent on the Friday right after pickup instead, the send date is on or before the good-through date and the payoff charge is $12500.00.
